# SB-1002 Safety bulletin: arc flash at the induction power cabinet

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P2, line P2-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L1-SB03

Hazard description
- Summary: An arc flash originating at the induction power cabinet adjacent to the Hot Forge shot blast cabinet has the potential to cause severe burns, ignition of shot media, and secondary energetic ejection of shot particles. The initiating mechanism is an electrical fault within the induction power cabinet that can produce a high-energy flashover into nearby metallic structures and particulate media. Personnel working at or near EQ-P2-L1-SB03 during cabinet access or routine top-up operations are at risk of direct thermal injury and of being struck by high-velocity shot media expelled from the cabinet.
- Background and recent observations: During routine maintenance rounds and archival review of maintenance records, an electrical incident was identified with root causes linked to inadequate control of stored conductive charge paths, proximity of unshielded terminals, and personnel presence during live work. The combination of conductive shot media and an arc flash source increases injury severity because hot ejecta can be propelled by the explosive pressure wave. Past procedural audits revealed inconsistent enforcement of work boundaries and incomplete isolation verification prior to access. This bulletin clarifies required actions to reduce likelihood and severity of arc flash events associated with the induction power cabinet serving the shot blast cabinet.
- Rationale for controls: Controls focus on eliminating or strictly controlling energy sources near particulate media, preventing ignition of shot media, and ensuring personnel are physically protected or absent during higher-risk activities. Controls emphasize administrative rigor, verification of isolation, physical barriers, and documented records to demonstrate compliance. Implementing the controls reduces the probability of initiating an arc and mitigates consequences if one occurs.

Affected equipment
- Primary: EQ-P2-L1-SB03
- Location: P2, line P2-L1
- Interfaces: induction power cabinet adjacent to EQ-P2-L1-SB03; access panels and shot media top-up points; local control housings and operator stations servicing the shot blast cabinet.
- Operational scope: all activities that require access to the shot blast cabinet or its adjacent service cabinets, including media top-up, inspection of wear lining, and any electrical work in the induction power cabinet vicinity.

Required controls
- Work authorization and isolation
  - All electrical work at the induction power cabinet shall be performed only after completion of lockout/tagout in accordance with SOP-P2-L1-03. Verification of zero energy and referenced isolation steps must be completed and recorded.
  - No routine maintenance, inspection, or media top-up shall occur while the induction power cabinet is energized and capable of supplying arc energy unless work is performed under an approved energized work permit in accordance with MM-P2-L1-SB03.
- Access restrictions and exclusion zones
  - Establish a controlled exclusion zone around the induction power cabinet and the shot blast cabinet during any condition where conductive particulate could be present within the cabinet and access is required. Personnel not involved in the task must remain outside the exclusion zone.
  - Access gates or temporary physical barriers must be used to define the perimeter when personnel are within the exclusion zone for authorized activities.
- Personal protective equipment (PPE) and procedural protections
  - When any live electrical exposure is unavoidable under an approved permit, affected personnel must wear PPE consistent with the highest hazard anticipated and per SOP-P2-L1-04. PPE selection, inspection, and replacement must be documented.
  - For media top-up operations and cabinet entry, use non-conductive tools and grounding verification devices approved under existing procedures. Avoid introduction of metal tools that could bridge energised terminals.
- Shot media controls
  - The shot media top-up interval for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P2-L1-SB03) is 33 hours. Use this interval to schedule media replenishment to avoid unattended accumulation of media near the induction cabinet during periods of electrical work.
  - When top-up is performed, ensure the induction power cabinet is isolated and verified safe according to SOP-P2-L1-03 before any access to media ports or removal of access panels.
- Inspection, maintenance, and housekeeping
  - Increase frequency of visual inspection of insulation, cable routing, and barrier integrity in the area adjacent to EQ-P2-L1-SB03. Document inspections and corrective actions in the cabinet maintenance log.
  - Keep the footprint around the induction power cabinet free of loose shot media and metallic debris that could create conductive paths. Housekeeping records shall be maintained and made available for review during audits.
- Training and communications
  - Conduct targeted refresher training for all personnel working on P2, line P2-L1 that covers arc flash risks specific to induction equipment, procedural steps from SOP-P2-L1-03 and SOP-P2-L1-04, and the administrative requirements in MM-P2-L1-SB03.
  - Post site-specific hazard notices at the entry to the cabinet area outlining required isolation, PPE, and the shot media top-up interval.

Examples and operational scenarios
- Example A: A technician scheduled media top-up during a routine production shift. Before opening the top-up port they must confirm LOTO per SOP-P2-L1-03 and log the activity. If induction power cannot be isolated immediately, defer the top-up until isolation is achieved to avoid creating a concurrent exposure to energized equipment.
- Example B: Electrical troubleshooting identified a hot terminal requiring observation. An energized work permit per MM-P2-L1-SB03 was issued; boundaries were established, PPE per SOP-P2-L1-04 was donned, and a non-conductive barrier was positioned between the terminal and the shot blast cabinet. The permit holder documented the start and stop times and attached the permit to the maintenance record.

Records to keep
- Lockout/tagout verification forms and LOTO completion checklists as required by SOP-P2-L1-03.
- Energized work permits and associated hazard analyses per MM-P2-L1-SB03.
- PPE inspection and issue logs aligned with SOP-P2-L1-04.
- Shot media top-up records showing adherence to the shot media top-up interval for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P2-L1-SB03) is 33 hours.
- Inspection logs and corrective action reports for the induction power cabinet area.
- Training attendance rosters and refresher quiz results for personnel assigned to P2, line P2-L1.

Effective date
- This bulletin is effective immediately upon issue and supersedes prior guidance for the induction power cabinet area. All affected personnel must comply with the required controls in this bulletin and reference the procedures MM-P2-L1-SB03, SOP-P2-L1-03, and SOP-P2-L1-04 when performing related activities. Compliance will be monitored through routine audits and review of the records listed above.
